WITH search_campaigns AS
  (SELECT campaign_id,
          channel
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.campaigns`
   WHERE LOWER(channel) = 'search' ),
     spend_data AS
  (SELECT s.spend_date,
          SUM(s.spend) AS total_spend
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.ad_spend` AS s
   INNER JOIN search_campaigns AS c ON s.campaign_id = c.campaign_id
   WHERE s.spend_date BETWEEN '2026-10-01' AND '2026-10-10'
   GROUP BY s.spend_date),
     leads_data AS
  (SELECT l.created_date,
          COUNT(DISTINCT l.lead_id) AS total_leads
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.leads` AS l
   INNER JOIN search_campaigns AS c ON l.campaign_id = c.campaign_id
   WHERE l.created_date BETWEEN '2026-10-01' AND '2026-10-10'
   GROUP BY l.created_date)
SELECT SUM(COALESCE(s.total_spend, 0)) AS total_spend_eur,
       SUM(COALESCE(l.total_leads, 0)) AS total_leads,
       SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(COALESCE(s.total_spend, 0)), SUM(COALESCE(l.total_leads, 0))) AS cost_per_lead_eur
FROM
  (SELECT DISTINCT spend_date AS dt
   FROM spend_data
   UNION DISTINCT SELECT DISTINCT created_date AS dt
   FROM leads_data) d
LEFT JOIN spend_data s ON d.dt = s.spend_date
